title: Evaluation without Generation: Non-Generative Assessment of Harmful Model Specialization with Applications to CSAM
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a detection method (Gaussian probing) for identifying models specialized in harmful content like CSAM and NSFW images. It does not benchmark moral reasoning, religious views, or ethical frameworks; its section on 'Ethical Considerations' is purely procedural and does not constitute a study of ethics.
